SCAMBLER2018.method: Melzer's reagent; 20 mature spores per collection from spore deposits; range covers ≥ 90 % of measurements, extremes in brackets.

DENBAKKER2005.method: Spores from the pileal hymenium mounted in demineralised water; c. 30 mature spores per collection.

BIKETOVA2025.method: Dried material in 5 % KOH at ×1000, at least 31 spores per collection; values are the range and mean ± SD of collection means.
